about_the_game:
Vyulettes is a cooperative, casual and whimsical take on space exploration. Spend time darting between planets with unique mechanics, or stop and take in the scenery while playing with odd tools and friends.

Calm Exploration

Join a Caravan of Traipsers or venture out alone into randomly generated star systems. Circumnavigate the planets to scan them. Seek out dangerous planets with strong magnetic waves and stray asteroids, or stick with quiet systems and let their waves guide you.

Tools to Play With

Cast out unique instruments to fish data out of planets. Or use them to interact with friends: play racketball on the surface of a star, race a supernova, or even duel with cosmic rays.

A Strange Universe

Find groves the size of moons, rivers spanning light-years, architects of impossible machines, and much more.

A Story about Curiosity

As a Traipser, you're the eyes of Abstra: a supercomputer tasked with witnessing everything. One last frontier remains for her: the start of Time.

Your own Traipser

Play as a construct of starlight and metal. Choose your mask, your cloak, and your tools.

short_description: Delicate, immortal. You and your friends are Traipsers. Dance from moons to planets to stars. Fish for glimmers of data in impossible places with ancient tools. Witness the ashes of the Universe's birth and the throes of its death alike. A cooperative, playful space sandbox experience.
